from.place: the bounded-above flat-complex clause: the bounded-above truncation case of the tensor acyclicity argument

title: Tensoring bounded-above acyclic complexes with bounded-above flat complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Let $A^\bullet$ be a bounded-above acyclic cochain complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules], and let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded-above cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Then the total complex $\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is acyclic.

source.place: Lemma 06YS, bounded-above case in the proof (the first-quadrant spectral sequence with $E_1^{p,q}=H^p(A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^q)$)
